definitions: The smallest structural and functional unit of an organism, typically microscopic and consisting of cytoplasm and a nucleus enclosed in a membrane.
A small room in a prison, monastery, or convent.
A device that produces electricity by a chemical reaction or by light.
A small, usually enclosed area within a larger structure or system.
A small group of people forming a secretive unit within a larger organization.
examples: Plant cells have a cell wall.
He spent a night in a police cell.
A solar cell converts sunlight into energy.
Each cell in the honeycomb was full of honey.
